summary: Expanded the node from obvious AI compute names into direct data-center physical infrastructure suppliers. The cleanest reference anchor is Vertiv for integrated power and thermal systems. The underfollowed lane is not truly small-cap anymore because many direct beneficiaries have re-rated, but Powell Industries, nVent, and IES Holdings still fit the Serenity lens as industrial, electrical, liquid-cooling, or contractor names whose exposure is closer to power distribution, cooling, and execution bottlenecks than to headline AI software or semiconductors.
